subject: Planning: Annual Review - phased notification plan & exception workflow
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@peopleops-consult.com
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Planning: Annual Review - phased notification plan & exception workflow

Team,

Attached is a first-pass plan for the annual review window. Key goals: reduce surprise for managers, protect sensitive role communications, and provide a clear exception path for late data / special-handling roles. Major pieces included in the package:

- Timeline: phased_release.xlsx — 3 waves (non-privileged -> privileged -> exec-level) with staggered employee notices.
- Manager checklist: manager_checklist_v1.docx — talking points, calibration anchors, required deliverables per manager.
- Employee notice draft: employee_notice_draft_vA.txt — short, non-evaluative notice for the first wave.
- Sensitive roles CSV: sensitive_roles_exemptions.csv — initial list from HR of roles flagged for bespoke handling.

High-level ask for leadership owners:
1) Confirm the wave dates below by end of day Monday (6/29).
   - Wave 1: 7/12 - 7/23 (individual contributors, non-privileged)
   - Wave 2: 7/26 - 8/6 (privileged roles & customer-facing leads)
   - Wave 3: 8/9 - 8/20 (senior execs and highly sensitive roles; manager-only notices)
2) Approve the manager checklist and employee notice language (I highlighted section we may need legal to review).
3) Confirm exception workflow owners and SLA for redaction/hold requests (proposed: 48-hour triage, 5-business-day resolution).

Notes on sensitive handling (please read):
- Any role appearing in the sensitive_roles_exemptions.csv will receive a manager-only briefing; employee communications are held until the review owner signs off.
- Managers can request a "vaulted notice" for special circumstances; form + DocuSign link will be provided after owner approval.
- We will run a manager training session (45 minutes) the week of 7/5 — please flag conflicts now.

PeopleOps Consulting (cc'd) will provide a short manager script and a two-item calibration rubric; they will also host a 30-minute office hour on 7/8 for tricky cases.

Next steps: internal alignment this week, send final wave schedule and manager materials by EOD 6/30, and publish the employee notice sequence on 7/10.

Thanks — quick call if needed (I can be on at 3pm PT today).

Naomi Feldman
Head of People Programs
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Attachments: manager_checklist_v1.docx; employee_notice_draft_vA.txt; sensitive_roles_exemptions.csv; timeline_phased_release.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Planning: Annual Review - phased notification plan & exception workflow

On Thu, 25 Jun 2026 at 13:05 Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team,
> 
> Attached is a first-pass plan for the annual review window...

Thanks Naomi — this is a helpful starting point. Two quick asks from the manager side:

1) Can we move the manager training to two shorter sessions (30 min each) the week of 7/5? A single 45-minute session blocks too many calendars for frontline managers; split will increase attendance.

2) The sensitive_roles_exemptions.csv has a handful of roles that should probably be marked "redaction-first" (example: Legal Ops, certain Sales AE lists). Can we add a column for 'redaction_priority' and a one-line reason? That will help triage.

I also noticed no explicit schedule for calibration meetings between IC and manager-level calibration leads. Suggest we add a 1-hour window after each wave to handle appeals / calibration questions (proposed 7/24, 8/7, 8/21).

If PeopleOps can prepare a manager micro-script and a one-slide checklist for the 30-min sessions (bullet list only), that will be super useful.

Laura Bennett
Director, Engineering Managers
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Attachment request: please include a CSV template for exceptions (name, role, reason, manager, requested-hold-until-date).

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 17:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Planning: Annual Review - phased notification plan & exception workflow

Laura — +1 on split sessions. A couple of operational points from infra/ops perspective:

- Escalation path: We need a named triage owner in each wave (prod and security liaison) so managers have a contact to escalate if an employee requests an immediate hold/redaction. Proposed: PRIO owners = priyom.das (ops triage) and kimberly.park (security liaison). Can you both confirm?

- Redaction SLA: 48-hour triage is fine but we should set expectation for "temporary hold" (acknowledgement within 48 hours) and a fuller resolution up to 7 business days for complicated requests. That gives us breathing room for legal reviews.

- Wording tweak for employee subject lines: avoid the word 'review' in wave 1 notice — it triggers anxiety. Suggest: 'Mid-year check-in & goal planning window' for Wave 1; save 'annual review' for Wave 3 exec communications.

Finally, we should lock down the DocuSign flow for exception approvals. Legal asked that approvals be auditable and timestamped; DocuSign link for manager sign-off + HR counter-sign should be the single source of truth. Naomi, can you loop in Legal once the CSV template is ready?

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Platform Reliability
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@peopleops-consult.com, jessica.holt@acme-inc.com, no-reply@docusign.com
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Planning: Annual Review - phased notification plan & exception workflow (updated)

Thanks all — quick update after reviews & PeopleOps feedback.

What I changed (attached updated files):
- timeline_phased_release.xlsx: incorporated Laura's calibration windows and shifted the manager training into two 30-min sessions (7/6 09:00 PT and 7/7 14:00 PT).
- sensitive_roles_exemptions.csv: added 'redaction_priority' and 'triage_reason' columns; included a sample exemptions CSV row for Legal Ops.
- manager_checklist_v1.docx: trimmed to a one-page micro-checklist for the 30-min sessions; added a short script for 'vaulted notice' conversations.
- employee_notice_draft_vA.txt: updated language per Vivek to avoid the word 'review' for Wave 1; created alternate subject lines per wave.

Exception workflow (final proposed):
1) Manager submits exceptions CSV row + brief rationale into the Drive template.
2) Manager signs exception approval via DocuSign (link below) -> HR countersigns within 72 hours.
3) Triage owners (priyom.das, kimberly.park) acknowledge the request within 48 hours and mark temporary hold in the tracker.
4) Resolution target: 5 business days for simple holds, up to 10 for complex redactions requiring legal review.

DocuSign link (test envelope): https://docusign.com/r/E7F3Q2-sample-envelopes
Drive folder (manager uploads & tracker): https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/review-2026/phase-plan

Action items for this week:
- PRs: priyom/kimberly confirm triage ownership (reply-all).
- Laura: confirm final calibration windows and the CSV exception template by EOD Monday (6/29).
- PeopleOps: finalize the 1-slide micro-script + office hour logistics (peopleops, please update the Drive).
- Naomi/Legal: I will loop Legal on Monday once CSV template is stable.

If there are no objections I will publish the manager pack on Monday evening and begin scheduling invites for the two training sessions.

Naomi Feldman
Head of People Programs
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Attachments: manager_checklist_v1.docx (updated); employee_notice_draft_vA.txt (updated); sensitive_roles_exemptions.csv (updated); timeline_phased_release.xlsx (updated)
